periods.label: Week of August 17, 2026
periods.summaryTitle: Shields, Inventory Overhaul, and Device Graphics

features: Added a toggleable Mana Shield as a new spell mechanic.
Enhanced feature development workflow with integrated planning phases and local LLM support.
bugfixes: Resolved an issue where the 3D cursor was incorrectly clamping to the radial map.
balance: The buckler's block chance has been scaled to dynamically increase based on the player's level.
ux: The inventory system was overhauled, replacing old item cards with detailed SVG tiles for better organization and accessibility.
The Whirlwind visual effect was refined, replacing the rotating cone with a continuous circular ribbon spin for smoother animation.
graphics: Implemented device-specific graphical presets, allowing mobile devices to default to lower settings (Lights/Shadows Off) while desktop uses maximum quality, while still honoring existing browser preferences.

commits.title: feat(graphics): default settings by device
commits.description:
